instruction: Assign the F12 key to instantly switch focus from the editor to the terminal during code editing.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring F12 as a keybinding to focus the terminal when the editor has text focus in VSCode. The evaluator checks if keybindings.json contains the entry with key='f12', command='workbench.action.terminal.focus', and when='editorTextFocus'. Uses existing check_json_keybindings metric and vm_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves VSCode keybindings.json file using get_vm_file getter
Metric check_json_keybindings correctly parses the JSON file (handling both direct JSON and commented JSON formats)

Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': accesses expected['expected'] to extract the keybinding dict, following the correct pattern since get_rule returns config['rules'] directly
Expected value correctly specifies all three required keybinding properties: key='f12', command='workbench.action.terminal.focus', and when='editorTextFocus'
Metric logic correctly verifies the keybinding by checking if the expected dict is present in the keybindings array
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all instruction requirements (F12 key, terminal focus command, editor text focus context)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns file path (str) -> metric loads and parses JSON -> compares against expected keybinding dict

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_keybindings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_keybindings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
